breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states that the internal axial force N(x) is 'piecewise-constant over each segment AB, BC, and CD, with jumps at B and C equal to the applied point loads at those locations.' This directly corrects the flawed instruction that treated the internal axial force as uniform along the full length.

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification requires computing separate internal forces (N_AB, N_BC, N_CD), separate stresses (σ_AB, σ_BC, σ_CD), and separate segment elongations that are summed for the total displacement. This fully replaces the incorrect single net-load stress approach with the correct segment-by-segment analysis, matching the ground truth.
